text_diff: [word/document.xml] The nominal 4 ft x 8 ft sideline screen provides the color guard with a concealed area for storing equipment and making costume or equipment changes. The frame is constructed from 3/4-in. EMT conduit, off-the-shelf brackets, and 3D-printed parts. Decorative vinyl covers the finished face. The completed screen folds flat for transport and storage and unfolds for field deployment.
